options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.doc_fr:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Trap Chance
options.doc: Percentage chance that any given filler item will be replaced by a trap.
options.doc_fr: Pourcentage de chances que tout élément de remplissage donné soit remplacé par un piège.

options.name: Randomize Compatibility Chips
options.doc:
Randomizes compatibility chips.
Each action that gets you them has as many checks as it would have chips normally.
Each chip is an item.

options.name: Additional Compatibility Chips
options.doc:
Adds x amount of extra compatibility chips to the item pool (if there are not enough locations left, it will cut off).
This only matters if compatibility chips are randomized.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute x quantité de puces de compatibilité supplémentaires au pool de l'article (s'il n'y a pas assez d'emplacements, il sera coupé).
Cela n'a d'importance que si les puces de compatibilité sont randomisées.

options.name: Randomize Enemy Death
options.doc: Adds locations for killing enemies.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute des emplacements pour tuer des ennemis.

options.name: Randomize Salesmen

options.name: Randomize Blueprints
options.doc: Randomizes blueprints

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: Whether deathlink will be used.

options.name: Death Link Amnesty
options.doc: The amount of deaths required to send a deathlink.

options.name: Death Link Grace
options.doc: The amount of deathlinks required to die.

options.name: Knockback Link
options.doc:
Whether knockback link will be used.
This protocol sends a link whenever the player receives knockback.

options.name: Knockback Link Sources
options.doc:
The sources that the player should send a knockback link from.
Acceptable values in this set are:
- Any (all sources)
- Actions (all actions)
- Enemies (all enemies)
- Bounds (the level bounds)
- Individual action names or enemy names, in constant case (such as RED_PILL or ZIG)

options.name: Actions Needed
options.doc: The amount of actions needed to goal. If this is 37 or less, it is possible to win without any checks.

options.name: Completion Shape
options.doc:
The extra shape that you will need to scan to goal, after all other requirements.
If left blank, there is no ending shape needed. This must be either in binary or hexadecimal (starting with '0x' for hex, and either nothing or '0b' for binary) formats.
Example: 0xfec68aba9ac6fe (The game's logo)

options.name: Needed Patterns
options.doc:
The extra patterns needed to goal. If left empty, none are needed.
These must be either in binary or hexadecimal (starting with '0x' for hex, and either nothing or '0b' for binary) formats.
